apple_app_store.subtitle: Trauma-Informed AI Journaling
apple_app_store.promotional_text: The World's First Identity OS. A safe space for healing through AI-powered journaling designed specifically for trauma survivors.
apple_app_store.description:
ALCHM is a trauma-informed, AI-powered journaling platform designed to support your healing journey through reflection and personal growth.

🌿 TRAUMA-INFORMED DESIGN
• Built with trauma survivors in mind
• Gentle, non-triggering interface
• Crisis detection and safety resources
• Respect for your healing pace

🤖 INTELLIGENT AI SUPPORT
• AI that understands trauma responses
• Personalized insights and reflections
• Pattern recognition for growth tracking
• Privacy-first processing

🛡️ PRIVACY & SECURITY
• End-to-end encryption
• No data sharing with third parties
• Local processing when possible
• Complete control over your data

🆘 CRISIS SUPPORT
• Automatic crisis detection
• Immediate access to 988 and crisis resources
• Professional referral suggestions
• 24/7 safety net features

✨ FEATURES
• Intelligent journaling prompts
• Mood tracking and patterns
• Goal setting and progress tracking
• Gamified healing elements
• Offline functionality
• Multi-device sync

ALCHM is designed for users 17+ and includes mature content related to mental health and trauma recovery. This app is not a substitute for professional mental health treatment.

If you're experiencing a crisis, please contact 911 or the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline immediately.

apple_app_store.review_notes:
ALCHM is a mental health app designed specifically for trauma survivors. The app includes:

1. Crisis detection features that provide immediate access to professional resources (988 Lifeline, Crisis Text Line)
2. Clear medical disclaimers stating the app is not a substitute for professional care
3. Age restriction to 17+ due to mature mental health content
4. Comprehensive privacy policy and data protection measures
5. Professional crisis intervention resources integrated throughout

The app follows trauma-informed care principles and encourages users to seek professional help when needed. All content is designed to support, not replace, professional mental health treatment.

google_play_store.short_description: Your digital sanctuary for healing through AI-powered journaling. Designed for trauma survivors.
google_play_store.full_description:
ALCHM is a trauma-informed, AI-powered journaling platform that provides a safe space for healing, reflection, and personal growth.

🌿 TRAUMA-INFORMED APPROACH
Built specifically for trauma survivors with gentle, non-triggering design principles. Features crisis detection, safety resources, and respect for your healing journey.

🤖 INTELLIGENT AI COMPANION
Our AI understands trauma responses and provides personalized insights, pattern recognition, and growth tracking while maintaining your privacy.

🛡️ PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST
• End-to-end encryption for all journal entries
• No data sharing with third parties
• Local processing when possible
• Complete control over your information

🆘 INTEGRATED CRISIS SUPPORT
• Automatic crisis detection system
• Direct access to 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
• Crisis Text Line integration
• Professional mental health referrals

✨ KEY FEATURES:
• Intelligent journaling prompts
• Mood tracking and emotional patterns
• Healing pathway recommendations
• Goal setting and progress visualization
• Gamified recovery elements
• Offline functionality
• Cross-device synchronization
• Multiple subscription tiers

🔒 SAFETY & COMPLIANCE
Designed for ages 17+ with mature mental health content. Includes comprehensive medical disclaimers and clear statements that the app is not a substitute for professional care.

ALCHM encourages users to work with qualified mental health professionals and provides easy access to crisis resources when needed.

If you're experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or the 988 Lifeline immediately.
